description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), causes [Imperil Prismatic 10% (15s)]/[Imperil Prismatic 30% (15s)] if 0-3/4+ FF9 allies are alive, grants [Tri-Element Mode III (Fire, Ice, Lightning)], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Reckless Blade] to the user

description.name: Imperil Prismatic 10% (15s)
description.text: Causes [Imperil Fire 10% (15s)], [Imperil Ice 10% (15s)], [Imperil Lightning 10% (15s)], [Imperil Earth 10% (15s)], [Imperil Wind 10% (15s)], [Imperil Water 10% (15s)], [Imperil Holy 10% (15s)], [Imperil Dark 10% (15s)] and [Imperil Poison 10% (15s)]

description.name: Imperil Prismatic 30% (15s)
description.text: Causes [Imperil Fire 30% (15s)], [Imperil Ice 30% (15s)], [Imperil Lightning 30% (15s)], [Imperil Earth 30% (15s)], [Imperil Wind 30% (15s)], [Imperil Water 30% (15s)], [Imperil Holy 30% (15s)], [Imperil Dark 30% (15s)] and [Imperil Poison 30% (15s)]

description.name: Tri-Element Mode III (Fire, Ice, Lightning)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Ice 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking] after using a Fire/Ice/Lightning ability

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Reckless Blade
description.text: Grants [Soul Break Gauge +250] to the user after using Full Break Rush or Iceflame Thunder Slash, removed after triggering, removed if the character hasn't [Synchro Mode]
